notes.content:

The time has come, [b]the Worlds Finals are here![/b]

You have until November 2nd to get THE esports manager featuring PSG, Heretics, TSM, Fnatic, and the current Worlds Semifinalist G2 Esports. at a 40% discount. https://store.steampowered.com/app/897410/Esports_Life_Tycoon

This is the perfect moment to reflect on the season so far and experience your own professional journey as an esports manager in Esports Life Tycoon. What's your favorite team? What were the best plays in the competition? Which players stood out during the whole year? But most importantly...

[h3]Which team are you rooting for: DAMWON or Suning? Leave a comment below with your prediction for the Finals![/h3]

See you at the Summoner's Ravine!

The U-Play Online and Raiser Games Teams.

notes.title: Introducing Post-launch Hotfix 1.0.1!
notes.content:
Dear esports managers,

Today we are introducing a couple of fixes to tailor the ultimate Esports Life Tycoon experience! You can check the changes introduced with the [b]Post-launch Hotfix 1.0.1[/b] right here:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the PS4 controller and its right joystick.
[*] Now there won't be any crashes when you are eliminated in the game and you don't have a save data to load.
[*] Zooming in during the gaming house segment could cause a visualization error in Mac OS. That's no longer a possibility!
[*] We've changed the descriptions of the Steam Achievements related to the Challenges. Go check them out! 
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]
We would like to remind you that this 1.0.1 hotfix isn't related to the previous 1.0.1 version. We started [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/897410/view/2885074013952670849]renaming the updates[/url] after the launch of Esports Life Tycoon to reflect its full release from Early Access.

Thank you for playing Esports Life Tycoon and see you in the Summoner's Ravine!

The U-Play Online and Raiser Games Teams.

notes.title: Esports Life Tycoon Leaves Early Access Today!
notes.content:
Dear esports managers,

[h3]Today is the day: [b]¡Esports Life Tycoon launches out of Early Access today![/b][/h3]

Celebrate with us the most important event of Esports Life Tycoon by playing [b]the new 1.0 Release Update[/b]. You only have until [b]September 9th to get the game for just 11,99€/$, starting today at 19:00 CET/10 am PST, before the price increases to 19,99€/$[/b] , so share the news with your friends and let the matches begin!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/897410/Esports_Life_Tycoon/

Here's everything we are introducing to Esports Life Tycoon in the 1.0 Release Update:

[h3]CHANGES TO ALL THE MAIN ACTIVITIES[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Energy is no more![/b] You still have a limited time to design your daily routine, but your players won't need to rest during the day to perform tasks.
[*] [b]Introducing Morale[/b]: Keep this new trait high to obtain an extra bonus for the rest of the activities. If you neglect morale, your players will get depressed and your team stats for the next match will lower.
[*] Scouting is being replaced by a new activity: [b]Analyze Rival[/b]! It works in the same way, but the order in which you reveal your opponent's strategy is now random. Its current velocity is also decreasing.
[*] Chemistry stays the same, but its name is changing to [b]Tactics[/b], which better reflects what you do in this activity.
[*] Hype now rewards you with [b]more money[/b]. [url=https://youtu.be/vBYJdZlpBT4]Ka-ching[/url]!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/6bc4ce7240297727521e1998fa1fa1a4a67bf827.png[/img]

[h3]IMPROVED MECHANICS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now, you can see the [b]odds of winning in each lane[/b] if you decide to automatically resolve your match. This will help you to better understand your chances of emerging victorious from each game.
[*] [b]New players are now featured on the player market each Monday[/b]. Do not forget to do a weekly check-in to discover promising younglings or stars free from their contracts!
[*] Each challenge is displaying [b]a new difficulty indicator[/b] to rank them by how hard they actually are.
[*] You can now [b]edit your CEO and players at any given moment[/b]: not only their physical appearance but also their personal data (birth name, nicks, etc.), customizing your team however you like!
[/list]

Thank you for accompanying us on this development journey through the world of Esports. We encourage you to keep participating in the community by sharing your opinion and feedback on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/897410/discussions/]the Steam forums[/url].

See you in the Summoner's Ravine!

The U-Play Online and Raiser Games Teams.

notes.title: Let the Challenges Begin: Introducing a New Game Mode... Today!
notes.content:
Dear esports managers,

Today, we are issuing you [b]a critical quest[/b]. There are 7 esports teams who need your help, each one with their own trials and tribulations. As their new manager, you are in charge of reverting their situations, saving them from their own failures and leading them to glory! Are you the right person to redeem these players?

[h3][b]These are the 7 challenges we are daring you to face:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/2837ecc0ac48881480b07db0d4205adf8c419ad6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/a3a8f9673b24f4f3bbde70ac6140c633c39cc3bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/a36fdf2a736a511092aecbfdb7536e463a19f403.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/f76753daa182e0af6d424391d772e41b9496e4c1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/3402a7a108426b50ceb57df80ef74c8f7107c4b2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/c3b9259fa366eaaf76205b43f43cdf43c59b24c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/f6ce6f11dd83ac9ca617019a056762d3e03f2f5c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Update 0.9[/h3]
We are also taking this opportunity to introduce [b]several quality-of-life fixes[/b] to improve the overall gameplay experience and... [b]gamepad support[/b]! You can now play Esports Life Tycoon with your favorite gamepad, we encourage you to try this new way of experiencing the life of an esports leader!

notes.title: Introducing a New Game Mode: Welcome to the Challenges!
notes.content:
Dear esports managers,

We are happy to announce a full, new game mode is coming to Esports Life Tycoon: [b]the Challenges[/b]!

Each of the seven different challenges will introduce you to an esports team experiencing a critical moment in their season. As their new manager, you are the only one that can help them overcome their current situation and save the day!

[h2][b]These are the seven challenges we are daring you to face:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Injury plague[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/db45c4b2f696bbeba5cab9b0c2f848570fcb6aab.jpg[/img]
The season has started and [b]four out of your five players are injured[/b]. Will you sacrifice precious victories to let them fully heal or substitute them with new players? You'll have to find a way to overcome this problem and accomplish the sponsor's objective!

[h3][b]Saved in extremis[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/9b2a7867b67ea107587b59beae4c6e3e432022c8.jpg[/img]

It's mid-season already. Our team is last on the leaderboard with 0 points. Only 6 matches remain… And you are the new manager in charge of reversing this dooming situation. Defy your fate and [b]avoid descending from category[/b]!

[h3][b]The locker room is a battlefield[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/1da568892a0755cd54f9d3f4432cc9f98895da09.jpg[/img]

You have a great team, but your players [b]LOVE THE DRAMA[/b]. Disaster looms in the locker rooms… Do you have the nerve to control your players' egos and take them to glory?

[h3][b]In the red[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/777d2ce03e90f9a9fd8c82a30b37291f6dc333d0.jpg[/img]

The team had a good first week and you're at the top of the leaderboard, but the previous manager emptied the club's coffers! Now, the directive has brought you in to fix these economic problems. A good leader has to make the toughest of choices: [b]which players and staff members will you let go to survive?[/b]

[h3][b]Perfect season[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/6091150b6fe63515f50d01a1215a8cfbcb4e9915.jpg[/img]

You've got the best players in the league. Heck, your team may even be the best one in the world! The expectations are so high that [b]you cannot afford to lose any match[/b]. Become the best champion in history by achieving a perfect season!

[h3][b]Making history[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/c0e3600774c477c8722edabdf9b6970adb77738c.jpg[/img]

G2, SKT1, Fnatic, TSM... All the greatest teams in the world had humble beginnings. This is the time you start your own story. [b]Win the tournament with a modest team[/b] of the inferior leagues and achieve your first feat as a legendary manager! 

[h3][b]Survival[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/dc7e8749f6c27f021d47c3529f8eed2627f87867.jpg[/img]

Your team promoted from Bronze to Gold League in just two seasons... But neither your players nor your economy can compete with the new opponents. Everyone thinks it's impossible to remain at this level... Prove them wrong. Face the overwhelming odds as a true leader and [b]complete the toughest of challenges[/b]!

[h2]What's coming after the Challenges?[/h2]

After introducing the Challenges in Esports Life Tycoon, we will spend some time testing them with you before leaving Early Access. This will indicate to us which Challenges you like the most and make the necessary tweaks to make them even more exciting.

Stay tuned to know more about the challenges, including [b]their release date[/b]! [i]Thank you, fellow esports fans!
[/i]
The U-Play and Raiser Games teams.

notes.title: The Beta Champions Team Joins the Tournament in ESLT Newest Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/3f39caac2f0f88aa723bb1f57b36ffae1d9b67f0.jpg[/img]

What’s up, esports fans?

This new update introduces a couple of highly anticipated features, such as the inclusion of the champions of the [b]beta competition[/b] as an NPC team, as well as the ability to monitor the rivals’ tactics.

[b]Here’s a list of the new features arriving with this 0.8 Update:[/b]

[h1]Meet the beta champions![/h1]
Do you remember the beta we held some time ago? If you do, you may also remember that we promised the winners would [b]be part of the game[/b]. 

Well, the wait’s over: meet Fals Mans e-Sports Club, a team formed by [b]Zetaka, kimura, DookieBrown and Thomasthegama[/b], the four Esports Life Tycoon players who won that competition. Take a look at their unique crest and kit designed by [b]Pau Fuentes[/b], the winner of Beta Design contest. 

They will be part of the [b]Silver division[/b] – and they can’t wait to face you on the battlefield! And who knows, maybe you end up firing them, since all their squad members will be available for you to hire. 

[b]Congratulations to all the winners![/b]


[h1]Change the course of the matches.[/h1]
We also made significant changes to the live matches. Now, you can see how your rivals develop their tactics during a game. It means that you will be able to check how they are reacting to your playstyle. 

The new live statistics feature will let you understand what is happening in the arena. And all this data will be useful for you as a coach: give orders more precisely to ensure that your team clashes the opponent!


[h1]New notification icons.[/h1]
We wanted all the icons to look similar so notifications will now be more relatable to other icons in-game.


[h1]Bug fixing. [/h1]
Because that’s what patches are for… aren’t they?


[h1]Parles català?[/h1]
Since the development team is based in Barcelona, we have added Catalan to the available languages.



We hope you enjoy these changes, and we’re looking forward to your feedback and suggestions for future updates! 

Thanks and good luck in the arena, coach!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7.3 IS UPON US!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35055480/b5e36ed50e10884daddd5fe78919342d7b45556c.jpg[/img]

Dear esports fans,
Your suggestions are essential to making the game we all want. We hear you, and that’s why we bring you a new patch full of improvements based on your feedback.

[h1]0.7.3[/h1]

[b]BUGS[/b]
[list]
[*] The exploit that allowed skipping matches is gone. Fame and glory must be earned!
[*] The Players tab now behaves correctly when closing info screens.
[*] Player model rotation has been reassigned to the right mouse button, making it feel more natural.
[*] The Starters tab closes correctly and player files are removed upon opening other info screens.
[*] CEO’s emails from other teams have been improved.
[*] You can now pause matches without any glitches in the simulator.
[*] Player files can no longer be opened from screens where they shouldn’t be appearing.
[*]Now, Sponsor events can only happen when you have a sponsor.
[*] No more graphic glitches after a player overcomes a depression.
[*] Status balloons now behave correctly when a player leaves the house.
[*] Player images in their tabs now have a better resolution.
[*] Players no longer wear jerseys from other teams; now, they always show their true colors!
[*] Female player models have been adjusted to fix graphic glitches.
[*] And many other small improvements to make the game more stable!
[/list]

[b]BALANCING:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players no longer retire when they’re 23-25 years old; now they can play until they’re 28.
[*] Experience points for Gold potential players have been increased.
[/list]

We hope all these upgrades will make your game experience even better! And, of course, don’t hesitate to contact us via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/897410/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/nrBMDF7]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Play the new 0.6 Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35055480/68419d9bc53af865851bf9393cdb4b09d71c55f8.jpg[/img]

Dear esports fans,

We hope you are having a splendid summer full of fun and video games! We continue working hard improving [b]Esports Life Tycoon[/b] after its Early Access release and we are happy to announce that we have a new update for you. Your feedback and suggestions on the Steam forums and Discord channel are essential to us so, don’t forget to stop by and say hello!

Here are some of the improvements, tweaks and new features that Update 0.6 will bring to the table:

[h1]Update 0.6[/h1]
[list]
[*] Time to take your team to the next level! [b]Characters now have a new trait: potential[/b]. This stat will give you a peek at how good they could become. Players with [b]Gold [/b]potential will be able to improve much more than those with [b]Silver [/b]potential. The same logic applies to the players with [b]Bronze [/b]potential. You can check the player’s potential thanks to a new menu button, but it will cost you some money. 
[*] From now on, [b]players will age[/b] as they would do in real life. Every season equals a year of their life and they will retire sometime around the age of 23 but, before doing so, they will tell you in advance so you can scout the market for a replacement. Make sure you hire another incredible player!
[*] Prepare to manage more realistic agreements! [b]Player contracts have been revamped[/b]. They will now be measured in seasons having a maximum length of three seasons.
[*] Players will get your attention when they face their last contact year so you can decide whether you want to [b]renew them or set them free[/b] at the end of the season. Are you ready to take the hardest decision?
[*] When hiring a Marketing employee, you can also choose a secondary sponsor instead of having to wait until the start of the next season.
[*] [b]Players no longer get tired during preseason[/b]. Seize their potential!
[*] If you decide to play a match instead of resolving it, [b]you can go back during the draft screen to change your decision[/b]. You won’t have to regret misclicking again!
[*] You can [b]rotate your character[/b] in the character editor to get the full view!
[*] Fixed some issues during negotiations so [b]the information displayed now is more precise[/b].
[/list]

What do you think about these changes? We hope this update addresses some of your concerns as well as giving you some new features that we are excited for you to try out. Please, do not forget to [b]keep giving us your precious feedback[/b] as it helps us shape the game in your preferred direction. As an Early Access title, Esports Life Tycoon will continue to add new content during the following months and much of it will come from your recommendations.

[b]Have the best of luck out there on the arena![/b]

The U-Play Online and Raiser Games Teams

notes.title: New 0.5 Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35055480/f2619ee49c0fac1cf56978cfa175fed1472f0a87.jpg[/img]

Dear esports fans,

How's summer? We're working hard here at U-Play Online, gathering your feedback and developing Esports Life Tycoon into the best esports manager ever!
Today’s update is based on what you told us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/897410/discussions/]Steam discussion forum[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/KkJ5KZS]Discord[/url].

Here's everything we are adding today:

[h1]Update 0.5.[/h1]
[list]
[*] The task system has been totally reworked! Now, you can increase Hype, Training, and Chemistry infinitely before matches. You'll always have something to do in the gaming house!
[*] Tasks now offer more information: we've changed tasks to a numerical value to give you a better understanding of your upcoming match, as well as an expected result of how your team will perform against your rival. Task performance will be improved as you climb divisions.
[*] Chemistry and Training rebalanced: now, they are both equally important in preparation for the matches.
[*] Energy tweaked: now escalates according to your gaming house improvements.
[*] Each room can now be improved 5 times per gaming house, which means more growth capacity for your players!
[*] You now need a minimum amount of fans to reach higher divisions. In return, Hype now grants more fans. Popularity is essential for an esports team to succeed!
[*] Economy adjusted: more income from Sponsors and Hype, more expensive gaming houses, cheaper players' clauses and sales... Balance your profit and losses to avoid bankruptcy!
[*] There are now more Sponsors than ever before: 4 sponsors per division, 24 in total. Choose the right one according to your current situation!
[*] General balancing to allow a more logical progression through all the game, including a lower requisite CEO level to move to new gaming houses
[/list]

[b]Also, lots of issues have been fixed in this update, thank you for helping us to spot them![/b]

WARNING: due to the sponsors' tweaks, there may be some save files which can contain sponsors that do not correspond to their season, which can lead to more or less income than expected. After ending the current season, it's automatically fixed.

We also have a surprise on this update: we have introduced [b]a random event featuring a special guest[/b]! If you happen to come across this character, take a screenshot and share it with us on Steam and/or Discord!

How do you feel about these changes? Keep giving that precious feedback to us! Help us steer the game in your preferred direction as we're listening for every word you've got to say. Remember that, as an Early Access title, we'll be developing Esports Life Tycoon with the help from the community.

Best of luck for your esports careers!

See you soon,
The U-Play Online & Raiser Games Teams

notes.title: Update 0.4.1 is here! More updates still coming
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35055480/57c85ac075d0150fd692b02a50355eeabfac882b.jpg[/img]
Dear esports fans,

The first update of Esports Life Tycoon is among us!

We are listening to all your feedback, reviews and suggestions in both Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/Wkd7ZsN]Discord[/url]. We are noticing that many of your petitions need more development time, so we have focused on the quickest changes we can make to Esports Life Tycoon in order to improve the state of the game ([b]balancing changes, quality-of-life tweaks, and bug fixing[/b]), while we are still working in other pressing topics.

You can discover here the changes we are introducing in the game today.

[h1]Update 0.4.1 Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Doing hype will now give you money from sponsors, even if you lose!
[*] Players statistics now have a greater impact in simulated matches
[*] Energy rises faster and decreases slower, giving you more time for other activities
[*] Training escalates quicker and provides a bonus to the team value during played (not resolved) matches
[*] Chemistry rebalanced: now grants fewer advantages during simulated matches
[*] You can now sell players to other teams even when the first team rejects your offer
[*] More than 20 bugs fixed
[/list]
This update follows last Tuesday's Hotfix to improve upon the state of Esports Life Tycoon. Of course, this will be just the first of many hotfixes and updates – as we said, this is a stage for growth and polishing, and we will keep working in the game for the entire Early Access and beyond. 

Thanks a lot for your trust and patience, and have a great weekend!

The U-Play Online & Raiser Games Teams

notes.title: Esports Life Tycoon launches on Early Access 20th of June!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35055480/059fa6a914e770851a412fa391e62bb7fc04df0c.gif[/img]

[h1][u]We have a date![/u][/h1]
[b]Esports Life Tycoon[/b] launches on Early Access 20th of June with a 20% launch discount (only until 9th of July). Furthermore, [b]Youtubers Life or Esports Life: Ep. 1 - Dreams of Glory owners will get an additional 30% loyalty discount[/b] for a total of -50%!

[h1][u]Thanks to all beta testers[/u][/h1]
All of you who joined our [url=https://discord.gg/wkdfYDP]Discord Server[/url] and helped us beta test our game, gave feedback... all 4,000 of you, thank you very much for your collaboration.

[h1][u]About Esports Life Tycoon[/u][/h1]
Manage your own esports team. Sign up the best players. Train your super stars. Deal with distractions and critical events before every match. Expand your team and gaming house to win major tournaments around the world until you become the greatest esports team!

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list][*]Create your own esports team and customize everything, from the crest to the players kits
[*]Hire the greatest stars in order to achieve your goals: if a player doesn't suit your need, you know there's only one option for them
[*]Train your players and take care of their well-being thanks to team bonding, scouting and a healthy lifestyle!
[*]Grow your team in the most amazing gaming houses and hire coaches, psychologists and marketing managers to improve your players everyday lifes.
[*]Compete in the arena to become a legend: decide either to witness the matches or guiding your squad to glory[/list]

We hope you enjoy playing Esports Life Tycoon as much as we enjoyed making it. Remember to swing by the discussion forums to report any issues, talk about the game, let us know what you thinkg, etc.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/897410/discussions/

Have fun,

The U-Play Online Team

notes.title: Join our FIRST BETA and new DISCORD CHANNEL!
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/V4br642][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35055480/88d0aad764f78da24b268c5a00ad8810a30fc90c.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Hello there future esports stars![/h1]

We're getting closer to [b]Esports Life Tycoon[/b] launch date and we've got an exciting announcement to make:

First of all: we are opening a [url=https://discord.gg/V4br642][b]Discord Server[/b][/url]! Join us to participate in an exclusive closed beta that will take place between June 6th (1pm EST/7pm CEST) and June 10th (4am EST/10am CEST)!

What can you expect to find in this Beta?
[list][*]Character and Team Customization: Design your manager and players, your shield, your clothing...
[*]Two gaming houses! Each one with its own features
[*]Training, scouting, teamworking... All the activities necessary to achieve greatness!
[*]Simulated esports matches: Decide between witnessing the pay-off of the match or guiding your squad by drafting heroes and making strategic decisions
[*]Play the first Division! 11 matches to reach the glory of becoming Champion![/list]
This is an exclusive, free beta that only the players in our Discord Server will have access to, so don't forget to join our Discord server to receive your own Beta Steam key through this link: https://discord.gg/xuSE4Sw

Now, a nice surprise...

[h1][b]THE BETA CHAMPIONS CHALLENGE[/b][/h1]

Everyone that plays Esports Life Tycoon during the Closed Beta can participate in this challenge and get the chance to [b]become a part of the game as a character[/b]!

[b]How can you become a Beta Champion?[/b]
[list][*]Manage your way to the top of the Division
[*]You’ll get an Exclusive Steam achievement. Share a screenshot showing the achievement AND Steam ID in our Discord server
[*]We'll hold a drawing with everyone that finished the previous step to select 5 lucky players. These 5 players will be represented in Esports Life Tycoon as a professional esports team, with their real names and nicknames forever immortalized in the game![/list]

[b]Keep in mind that beta keys are temporary and will expire on June 10th[/b]

[h1]Join Esports Life Tycoon's community and drive your esports team to the top of the world![/h1]
